## Outcome

Describe the bounded outcome and its authority envelope.

## Self-documenting governance

- Work item ID(s):
- Evidence story ID(s):
- Exact verification commands or CI subjects:
- External state changed, if any:
- Remaining status: active / planned / blocked / deferred / complete
- Owner, next action, wait condition, re-entry condition, and stale date recorded in `governance/project-ledger.json`: yes / no
- `npm run governance:render` committed: yes / no

Do not mark an outcome complete from repository, CI, deployment, runtime, credential, review, or verifier evidence that proves only another state.
